findings.issue: n0771 (Notebookcheck, stamped 12 Feb) reports the Soros-Rivian US$2 billion stake, but the stake was disclosed in the Reuters item stamped 14 Feb and RIVN's +6.46% move is on the 14 Feb session; the 12 Feb stamp looks misdated and the dollar figure is unsupported by any other own-date headline.
findings.resolution: Removed the n0771 clause and the US$2 billion figure; claim now rests on Reuters n0840 only. n0771 recommended for exclusion.

findings.issue: 'the region's most aggressive inflation problem' is a regional comparison no cited headline supports.
Kansas City Fed headline is a question about small vs large bank NIMs; text asserted a conclusion (scale deposit gatherers with floating-rate assets).
findings.resolution: Reworded to say the research frames the question, with scale deposit gatherers as likeliest candidates (analytical inference, modal); trimmed Apollo wording to keep 150-200 words.

findings.issue: Asserted equities are discounting windfall taxation, citing a generic BBC explainer dated 8 Feb; cause of the price gap is not evidenced.
findings.resolution: Made modal ('may be discounting ... windfall-tax risk').

findings.issue: 'defence ... hold up' conflicted with LMT -2.33% and ITA -3.69%; 'regulators blocking vertical deals' generalised from a single Lockheed-Aerojet headline.
findings.resolution: Changed to 'hold up better' and tied the claim to the Aerojet deal only.

findings.issue: Stated that Japanese fuel-cost squeeze 'explains' the US utilities' fall; causal claim beyond headlines.
findings.resolution: Made modal ('may be part of the explanation alongside rates').

findings.issue: 'FEZ, where the drawdown is sharpest' is not true against the card (EPOL and others fell more over 20 sessions).
findings.resolution: Replaced with FEZ's own -1.08% day move.

findings.issue: 'keeping tariff relief off the table' and 'defaults beyond the Cedar case' overreach: headlines say targets missed and a $3.1bn overdue payment, not a default or a tariff stance.
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'leaving the trade backdrop unsettled' and 'further missed payments ... beyond Cedar's'.

findings.issue: 'treated as a margin victim' asserts a market view with no source.
findings.resolution: Reworded as a price pattern consistent with a margin victim.

findings.issue: 'protection buying' had no citation in the part.
findings.resolution: Added Bloomberg options-hedge n2182 (now 2 uses total).

findings.issue: 'net-cash acquirers', 'confirm pricing power' and 'protection is being bought' generalised from single headlines.
Reuters 'Scholz flies to Moscow' is day-stamped 14 Feb; the meeting itself must not be treated as having occurred. Text frames it only as pending, with no outcome.
findings.resolution: No change needed; verified no outcome, pull-back, Duma, PPI, RBA-minutes or Airbnb/Roblox/Upstart results appear. Airbnb/Roblox/Upstart appear only as card five-session moves 'ahead of next prints'.

findings.issue: Checked every cited ID against own-date feed: all published before 2022-02-15T00:00Z, company results within 14 days, news within 7 days, macro within 35; card numbers (yields, indices, equities, commodities, Polish names, crypto) verified against cards/2022-02-15.json; no numeric spot-FX, no META ticker (FB used), curve wording matches positively sloped / bear flattening; no other-date data found; stances and Playbooks consistent.

scope_limits: Reviewed only own-date feed, card, exclusions, brief and the writer note; headlines only, no article bodies, no web access. Day-granular 08:00 stamps (e.g. Scholz Moscow trip n1339, BHP result n0835, Super Bowl items) were judged against the stated guardrails; their exact intraday release times cannot be verified from the feed.

recommended_exclusions.reason: Notebookcheck Soros-Rivian US$2 billion item stamped 12 Feb precedes the 14 Feb disclosure reported by Reuters; likely misdated.
CNN 'Photos: Russia invades Ukraine' stamped 14 Feb describes an invasion that is after the cutoff; misdated or later-updated.
NPR 'Russia's at war with Ukraine' wording implies post-cutoff revision.
NPR gas article refers to 'the war in Ukraine'; likely later-revised.
BBC Pidgin item on Russia moving some troops away from the border describes the 15 Feb claimed partial pull-back, after the cutoff.
Reuters says Coinbase shares slip, contradicting the card's +0.37% close on 14 Feb; misdated or wrong direction.
Euronews German manufacturing 'October' PMI under a February stamp; misdated.
'Super Bowl LVII' headline under a February 2022 stamp is anachronistic.
